arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.head(15).to_string())

import openpyxl

path = "budget.xlsx"
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=False)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (dims {ws.dimensions}) ===")
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        vals = [(c.coordinate, c.value) for c in row if c.value is not None]
        if vals:
            print(vals)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

path = "budget.xlsx"
NS = {
    "main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "rel": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
    "pkgrel": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships",
}

def col_to_idx(ref):
    m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
    letters, row = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return idx, row

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    print("Archive contents:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print("  ", n)
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = wb.find("main:sheets", NS)
    sheet_names = [s.get("name") for s in sheets.findall("main:sheet", NS)]
    print("Sheet names:", sheet_names)
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rid_to_target = {r.get("Id"): r.get("Target") for r in rels.findall("pkgrel:Relationship", NS)}
    print("Relationships:", rid_to_target)

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

path = "budget.xlsx"
NS = {"main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}

def col_to_idx(ref):
    m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
    letters, row = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return idx, row

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    for c in root.iter("{%s}c" % NS["main"]):
        ref = c.get("r")
        t = c.get("t")
        v = c.find("main:v", NS)
        is_ = c.find("main:is", NS)
        val = None
        if v is not None:
            val = v.text
        elif is_ is not None:
            texts = [t.text or "" for t in is_.iter("{%s}t" % NS["main"])]
            val = "".join(texts)
        if val is not None:
            print(f"{ref} type={t} value={val!r}")

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = "budget.xlsx"
NS = {"main": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"}

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

expenses = []
for c in root.iter("{%s}c" % NS["main"]):
    ref = c.get("r")
    col = "".join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isalpha())
    row = int("".join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isdigit()))
    if col == "C" and 11 <= row <= 22:
        v = c.find("main:v", NS)
        if v is not None:
            expenses.append((row, float(v.text)))

total = sum(v for _, v in expenses)
print("Expense items (row, amount):", expenses)
print("Total expenses: %.2f" % total)

# Per-category breakdown from column A
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

cells = {}
for c in root.iter("{%s}c" % NS["main"]):
    ref = c.get("r")
    row = int("".join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isdigit()))
    col = "".join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isalpha())
    is_ = c.find("main:is", NS)
    v = c.find("main:v", NS)
    val = None
    if is_ is not None:
        val = "".join(t.text or "" for t in is_.iter("{%s}t" % NS["main"]))
    elif v is not None:
        val = v.text
    cells[(col, row)] = val

cats = {}
for row, amt in expenses:
    cat = cells.get(("A", row))
    cats.setdefault(cat, 0.0)
    cats[cat] += amt

print("\nPer-category totals:")
for cat, amt in cats.items():
    print(f"  {cat}: {amt:.2f}")
print("Grand total: %.2f" % sum(cats.values()))
